scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.audio: Can testimonial examples be fully trusted? Experience cannot be duplicated. The reason is that the human brain has a mechanism that easily falls into the placebo effect and the issue of brain activity.

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.audio: When I was a child, we lived in the countryside of Miaoli. Every week, my grandmother would take me to the temple. A small truck would drive in, and they would start performing.

scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.audio: They would start talking about who took this 'universal medicine' and got cured. Cancer was cured, diabetes was cured, high blood pressure was cured, and even asthma was cured.

scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.audio: So my grandmother bought several bottles of medicine. It wasn't until I got home that I realized I had taken it for two weeks and nothing had changed, and the medicine was very expensive.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: Why do I care so much that testimonial cases cannot be used as a basis for argument? The reason lies in the placebo effect. Perhaps 70% of diseases in the human body will heal naturally. So as long as I make a miracle medicine for you and give it to 100 people, 70 people will get better after taking it. Then you will think my medicine is miraculous, but in fact, what I prescribed was just Vitamin C. This is the placebo effect. Therefore, the placebo effect cannot be used as a basis for argument. The second is the issue of brain activity.

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.audio: For example, if you are researching a car today, looking at a BMW for a long time, and after three months of research, you have analyzed all the data and fuel consumption. You decide to buy a BMW.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: As a result, the day before you buy it, you hear your friend say that he bought a BMW that was terrible, and the new car was repaired 30 times in three months.

scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.audio: Then you most likely won't buy it. The brain is called a cognitive miser. A cognitive miser means it will use the least amount of energy to come up with a conclusion. The less energy the brain consumes, the longer you will survive in primitive society. We will only look at the most obvious case.
